title: Customer name on a detail row navigates the current tab to the customer's record
permissions_required: Reports/Performance access plus permission to open customer records.
preconditions: 1. A rep row is expanded with detail rows visible.
steps: 1. Click the customer name on a detail row.
expected: 1. The customer name is a clickable link that navigates the current tab to the customer's record.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Contrast with SBC where the customer name is plain text — the two reports differ by spec.
